links.comparator_used: Default prompt with no reading-level instruction (unprompted ChatGPT 4.0 and Bard output)
links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education materials (Flesch Reading Ease, SMOG and other readability indices)
links.effect: Unprompted ChatGPT 4.0: FRES 36.5, SMOG 14.7; prompted ChatGPT 4.0: FRES 67.9, SMOG 10.2. Both ChatGPT 4.0 and Bard significantly improved readability scores with the 6th-grade prompt.
links.quote: When prompted to produce PEM at a 6th-grade reading level, both ChatGPT 4.0 and Bard were able to significantly improve in their readability scores, with prompted ChatGPT 4.0 being able to consistently generate content that was easier to read (Flesch Reading Ease Score: 67.9, Simple Measure of Gobbledygook: 10.2).
